chapters.label: Soccer City
chapters.text: Johannesburg, 2010, the World Cup final. Spain, in dark blue, play the Netherlands, in orange. Nil-nil, with four minutes of extra time left. Fàbregas passes to Andrés Iniesta, and... goal!

chapters.label: Calm
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. Iniesta stays calm. He lets the ball bounce, keeps his head down and his body still.

chapters.label: The strike
chapters.text: Then he strikes it cleanly with his right foot, past Stekelenburg. Spain are world champions for the first time!

chapters.label: Big moments
chapters.text: In the biggest moment, stay calm. Settle your body, and strike the ball cleanly.
